A European TSO-DSO group — Energy & Utilities engagement delivered by a 23-person team over 16 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climbing.
CIP/62443 evidence assembled manually; flat zones persisted.

blocks.x: The forecasting platform couples weather to asset-level generation and demand with uncertainty bands feeding the scheduling hub; substation telemetry (transformer/breaker condition) now predicts failures; and the OT security program delivered 62443 zoning with continuous evidence — security preceded every instrumentation wave.

Delivery followed the standard rhythm — Diagnose with a signed baseline, Prove with falsifiable criteria, Industrialize with staged rollouts — while the control evidence (model cards, decision replay, security tests) accumulated as artifacts of the build.

items: Churn down 19% in target segments — event-triggered save hub
Case processing down 52% — document intelligence under accountable-AI gates

blocks.x: Towers: Data, Analytics & Lakehouse, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation, Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust. Platforms: Achala Forge, Achala Nexus, Achala Sentinel.

items: the platform configuration patterns and the operator enablement curriculum, refined across engagements of this type.
organizational absorption: adoption paths are designed for each client's operating culture, never assumed.
